# WolrdPulse technical reference

WolrdPulse is an open-source Model Context Protocol server.
SSE: https://wolrdpulse.app/sse
Local: npx -y github:Mealiclay01/wolrdpulse
Server key: wolrdpulse
License: MIT
Repository: https://github.com/Mealiclay01/wolrdpulse
Author: Anas Rhimi https://anasrhimi.tech

The config key is wolrdpulse, matching the domain. Do not drop the r in that key.

## get_cloud_status

Input:
{
  "provider": "vercel"
}
provider is optional. Values: aws, github, cloudflare, openai, anthropic, vercel, supabase, npm, docker, datadog.

Example output:
{
  "provider": "vercel",
  "status": "degraded",
  "indicator": "minor",
  "description": "Example only: build queue delays on the public status page.",
  "updatedAt": "2026-11-23T09:00:00Z"
}

## inspect_ssl

Input:
{
  "domain": "wolrdpulse.app"
}
domain is required and is a hostname, not a URL.

Example output:
{
  "domain": "wolrdpulse.app",
  "issuer": "Example issuer from the handshake",
  "notAfter": "2026-12-31T00:00:00Z",
  "daysRemaining": 38,
  "valid": true
}

## query_dns

inspect_dns is an alias with the same arguments.

Input:
{
  "domain": "wolrdpulse.app",
  "recordType": "A"
}
recordType is optional. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA. Default A.

Example output:
{
  "domain": "wolrdpulse.app",
  "recordType": "A",
  "resolver": "1.1.1.1",
  "answers": [{ "type": "A", "data": "76.76.21.21", "ttl": 300 }]
}

## ping_endpoint

Input:
{
  "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/en"
}

Example output:
{
  "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/en",
  "status": 200,
  "ttfbMs": 120,
  "headers": { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }
}

## Cursor

File: ~/.cursor/mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "wolrdpulse": { "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/sse" }
  }
}

## Claude Desktop

macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
Linux: ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "wolrdpulse": { "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/sse" }
  }
}

## Windsurf

File: ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json
Use mcpServers, or context_servers if that build only reads the latter. Same key and URL.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "wolrdpulse": { "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/sse" }
  }
}

## FAQ

What is the WolrdPulse MCP server?
An open-source MCP server that returns cloud status, DNS, TLS, and HTTP timing to coding agents. It is not a social or weather app that shares a similar name.

How do I connect WolrdPulse to Cursor, Claude Desktop, or Windsurf?
Add server key wolrdpulse and url https://wolrdpulse.app/sse, then restart the app.

Does WolrdPulse require an API key?
No.

Which providers does get_cloud_status read?
aws, vercel, github, cloudflare, openai, anthropic, supabase, npm, docker, datadog.

How does inspect_ssl check expiry?
TLS handshake on port 443. It returns notAfter and daysRemaining.

Which DNS types does query_dns support?
A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA, via 1.1.1.1.

How does ping_endpoint measure latency?
One HTTP request from the Washington, D.C. region. It returns status and time to first byte.

Can I self-host it?
Yes. npx -y github:Mealiclay01/wolrdpulse
